categories.name: Optimism Superchain Ecosystem

categories.name: Modular Blockchain
categories.content: A modular blockchain is a type of blockchain architecture that separates the core functions of a blockchain into distinct modules or layers. Each module is designed to handle specific tasks independently.

categories.name: Data Availability
categories.content: Data availability on the blockchain ensures that all participants have the transaction data needed to verify blocks, even with resource limitations and scalability needs. Without it, independent verification crumbles, compromising the entire system. Data availability centric protocols aim to allow nodes to verify data availability more efficiently.

categories.name: Rollup
categories.content: Rollup is a layer 2 solution that aggregates and processes transactions outside of a main blockchain, before submitting them as a single batch, to enhance scalability and reduce fees.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
